verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents its own bulk capabilities: transfers accept up to 500 domains at a time, and its API docs list setting auto-renewal across a whole portfolio. These cover only a few operation types, and the transfer limit is documented on the web transfer page rather than as an API batch endpoint. Missing for 10: bulk DNS record edits or bulk registration via API/MCP, a documented batch endpoint shape with partial-failure handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
